    contains 040221: Dairy produce; milk and cream, concentrated, not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter, in powder, granules or other solid forms, of a fat content exceeding 1.5% (by weight)

data.reason: Skimmed milk powder with 1% fat is concentrated milk in powder form with fat not exceeding 1.5%, which falls under heading 0402 (subheading 040210), not the non-concentrated milk of 0401.
